name: Luxor
tagline: An open-air journey through ancient Thebes
summary: Split the trip into an east-bank temple day and a west-bank tomb day. Early starts are more useful than cramming every monument into one hot afternoon.
seasonNote: The exposed sites are very hot in summer; cooler-season mornings are the most comfortable.
arrival: Fly from Cairo or use a separately booked rail service; arrange a hotel transfer if arriving very late.
gettingAround: A reputable driver or guide helps group west-bank sites. Walking works for only some east-bank stretches.
cashTip: Carry small EGP notes for agreed tips, water and meals; check card-payment arrangements at ticket offices.
foodTip: Try ful, grilled dishes and seasonal vegetables; choose established kitchens.
buyTip: Shop for clearly modern alabaster crafts or textiles; check provenance and avoid antiquities.
baseArea: East bank for restaurants and transport; west bank for a quieter base

connections.note: Approximate airborne time; airport transfers and check-in are extra.

reviewSummary: Valley of the Kings, Karnak and Luxor Temple all have strong high-volume ratings. Reviews particularly emphasize Karnak’s scale, so give it a full unhurried block.

items.name: Dendera Temple Excursion
